     8	
     9	| # | Change | v1 | v2 |
    10	|---|--------|----|----|
    11	| 1 | Endpoint prefix | `/tasks` | `/v2/tasks` |
    12	| 2 | Auth header | `X-Auth-Token` | `Authorization: Bearer` |

    21	
    22	All endpoints now include the `/v2/` version prefix.
    23	
    24	**Before (v1)**
    25	```
    26	GET /tasks
    27	POST /tasks
    28	PUT /tasks/42
    29	DELETE /tasks/42
    30	```
    31	
    32	**After (v2)**
    33	```
    34	GET /v2/tasks
    35	POST /v2/tasks
    36	PUT /v2/tasks/a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890
    37	DELETE /v2/tasks/a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890

    50	
    51	**After (v2)**

    53	Authorization: Bearer your_api_token_here
    54	```

    57	
    58	---

    60	## 3. Task ID Type
    61	
    62	Task IDs are now UUID strings instead of integers. Update any code that parses or stores task IDs.

    67	```
    68

    72	```

    85	```
    86

    89	{ "completed": true }
    90	```

   101	```json
   102	{ "title": "New task title" }
   103	```
   104	
   105	**After (v2) — Create Task**
   106	```json

   108	  "title": "New task title",
   109	  "project_id": "proj_abc123"
   110	}
   111	```
   112	
   113	> ⚠️ Obtain a `project_id` before creating tasks. Projects are managed separately in v2.
   114

   117	## 6. List Response Envelope
   118	
   119	List endpoints no longer return a bare array. They return a paginated envelope with `items`, `total`, and `next_cursor`.
   120	
   121	**Before (v1) — List Tasks**
   122	```json
   123	[
   124	  { "id": 1, "title": "Buy milk", "done": false, "created_at": "..." },
   125	  { "id": 2, "title": "Ship v1", "done": true, "created_at": "..." }
   126	]
   127	```
   128	
   129	**After (v2) — List Tasks**
   130	```json
   131	{
   132	  "items": [
   133	    { "id": "a1b2c3d4-...", "title": "Buy milk", "completed": false, "project_id": "proj_abc123", "created_at": "..." },
   134	    { "id": "b2c3d4e5-...", "title": "Ship v1", "completed": true, "project_id": "proj_abc123", "created_at": "..." }
   135	  ],
   136	  "total": 2,
   137	  "next_cursor": null
   138	}
   139	```
   140

   142	
   143	```

   145	```

   161	- [ ] **Test with a sandbox project** — verify all CRUD operations work end-to-end before migrating production

   165	## Upgrade Command

   167	Once you have completed the checklist:
   168

   176	yarn global add @zrb/cli@latest
   177	```
